title: Isotope-sequence and gated-graphene results bounded by measured interfaces and prior art
reported_status: The isotope route retains published Cu-ZIF-gis mixed-feed and thermal-cycle evidence as prior art, while the additional purge remains unqualified: under the stated two-species, feed-free, no-re-adsorption/no-exchange assumptions, doubling odds while retaining >=90% of captured D requires Λ_H/Λ_D>=7.578813; no same-bed mixed-feed fractional-release receiver balance or complete-cycle advantage is supplied. The Soong et al. graphene electrode route uses separate proton/deuteron electrolytes and has at most 3.3445 micrograms D/m^2 per fill even granting all-D occupation; mixed-feed selectivity, product collection and turnover are not established. J. Tong et al. 2026 tBLG and Tong et al. 2024 double-gated graphene are established original-author active-control prior art in their own apparatus; they do not establish transfer to hBN, batteries or these isotope operations. No new physical capability is demonstrated.

scientific_scope_status: The isotope route retains published Cu-ZIF-gis mixed-feed and thermal-cycle evidence as prior art, while the additional purge remains unqualified: under the stated two-species, feed-free, no-re-adsorption/no-exchange assumptions, for positive Λ_D, doubling odds while retaining >=90% of captured D requires Λ_H/Λ_D>=7.578813; zero D loss with positive H escape is the infinite-ratio limit; no same-bed mixed-feed fractional-release receiver balance or complete-cycle advantage is supplied. The Soong et al. graphene electrode route uses separate proton/deuteron electrolytes and has at most 3.3445 micrograms D/m^2 per fill even granting all-D occupation; mixed-feed selectivity, product collection and turnover are not established. J. Tong et al. 2026 tBLG and Tong et al. 2024 double-gated graphene are established original-author active-control prior art in their own apparatus; they do not establish transfer to hBN, batteries or these isotope operations. The compiled synthesis remains unreviewed; the cited papers are published prior evidence. No new physical capability is demonstrated.
